tei:div.tei:p: bsgrub pa'i phyir/ cho ga'i rim pa las kyi yan lag du ma dang bcas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i gzungs rnams bya ba'i rgyud kyi khongs su 'du zhing de dag gi /sna tshogs cho ga'i las kyi rim pa so sor gnas mod de lta na'ang*/ / bla ma rgyud pa man ngag rim pas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /lha mo rnam lnga bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs kho bos deng 'dir bstan zin to/ /dge ba gang zhig nam mkha'i ngos ltar rgya cher yangs pa gang bskrun pas/ /sdug bsngal rba klong rnam par 'khrugs pa'i srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba kun/ /rab tu bsgral nas yon tan nor bus rnam par bkra ba thar ba yi/ /gling mchog dam par stobs bcu'i stobs ldan bsnyengs bral mchog la 'god par shog /bsrung ba lnga'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i dge slong 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ shing mo yos bu'i lo gdu bu'i zla ba la sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /mngon par rtogs pa ste gnyis pa'o// //༄༅/ /bstod pa bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /bsrung ba lnga'i lha mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun rig pa'i rgyal mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /yon tan nor bu gdul bya'i dpal gyur pa/ /bla ma bzang po'i zhabs la gus btud de/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo rnams la bstod par bgyi/ / gzugs phung gnas gyur gti mug rnam dag pa/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi rigs las byung*/ /so sor 'brang ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston zla ltar gsal zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ /g.yas zhal char sprin lta bur cher gnag cing*/ /rgyab zhal gser mdog g.yon zhal dza ba'i mdangs | | gtsug tor mchod rten gyis brgyan phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen gyis spras bcu drug lon pa'i tshul/ /'khor lo rdo rje mda' dang ral gri g.yas/ / zhags pa rtse gsum gzhu dang dgra sta rnams/ /g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdong bzhi zhi ba dga' byed gos ser can/ /mkha' lding klu dbang gnod sbyin dri za dang*/ /mi 'am ci yi tshogs kyis gus mchod ma/ /byang chub shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs zhags pa'i 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing*/ /gzhan gyi sngags dang phyag rgya rdzas sbyor dang*/ /byad stems 'byed dang drag shul las rnams kun/ /rab tu 'joms ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo | | dkon mchog mchod la mngon par brtson pa dang*/ /brtse bas gzhan don gcig tu lhur len zhing*/ /theg pa mchog gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa rnams/ / yongs su skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam shes gnas gyur zhe sdang rnam dag pa/ /chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi rigs las byung*/ /stong chen rab 'joms zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i mdangs ldan zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ /g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar rgyab zhal ser/ /g.yon zhal ljang (《 zha 》 dmar ) zhing zhal rer spyan gsum ldan/

/ rngam pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' dang ral gri g.yas/ /zhags pa dang bcas sdigs 'dzub dgra sta gzhu/ /rin chen 'bar ba g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams/ /stag dang sbrul gyi brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nyi mar rol pas bgegs dang 'byung po mnan/ /ma mo bdun dang srin mo sha za mo | | gnod sbyin mo rnams rab tu skrag mdzad pa/ /tā la'i shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlung dang bad kan mkhris pa'i nad sel zhing*/ /thog dang ser ba rlung sogs gnod pa 'joms/ /dus min 'chi ba nges par zlog mdzad pa | | 'jigs byed khro mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshor ba gnas gyur ser sna rnam dag pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rigs las byung*/ /rma bya chen mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser bzangs mdog mtshungs zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ /g.yas zhal mig sman ltar gnag g.yon pa dmar/ /padma zla bar sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs/ / sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog sbyin bum pa 'khor lo ral gri g.yas/ /dge slong dang bcas lhung bzed rma bya'i sgro/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i bum pa dang*/ /rgyal mtshan g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bden pa grub pa'i drang srong rnams kyis mchod/ /srin mo'i tshogs 'joms klu rnams skrag mdzad cing*/ /lha ma yin rnams kun tu rmongs byed pa/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing drung bzhugs la 'dud/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug rnams rab 'joms shing*/ /dmod pa'i mda' dang 'phrul 'khor 'jigs par byed/ /sgrub po dri med bde la 'god mdzad pa/ /rig sngags rgyal mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'dud | | 'du shes gnas gyur 'dod chags rnam dag pa/ /kun rtog ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rigs las byung*/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan zhal gsum ma

| | g.yas gnag g.yon pa kunda zla ba'i mdog /spyan gsum padma rgyas 'dras 'gro la gzigs/ /rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcu gnyis phyag gi dang po chos 'chad tshul/ /gnyis pa mnyam bzhag mchog sbyin mi 'jigs sbyin/ /rdo rje mda' g.yas g.yon pa sdigs 'dzub zhags/ /bum pa snyem ma gzhu yis brel la 'dud/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis zhabs mchod cing | | rgyal chen bzhi yis rtag tu rim gror byed/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis gus btud pa/ /shir shi'i shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i sprul pas rnam rol zhing*/ /sngags kyi sbyor bas 'gro ba yongs su 'dzin// lha dang lha min klu dbang tshogs rnams kun/ /dbang du mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'du byed gnas gyur phrag dog rnam dag pa/ /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rigs las byung*/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhal gsum phyag drug margad mdog mtshungs pa | | g.yas dkar g.yon zhal karṇi ka yi mdog /rin chen 'od 'phros du mas rnam par brgyan/ /sgeg pa'i tshul 'chang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas mi 'jigs sbyin dang rdo rje mda'/ /g.yon pas zhags pa dang bcas sdigs mdzub dang*/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan dang ni gnam ru 'dzin/ /dpa' mo dgyes dgur spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin gyi mchod cing | | smyo byed brjed byed la sogs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /kun tu skrag mdzad bya yi gdon rnams 'joms/ /tsam pa'i shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug pa dang*/ /bskrad dang dbye dang gsad la sogs pa yi/ /las rnams thams cad so sor stsol mdzad pa/ /don kun sgrub byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog tu dad pa'i yid kyis bskul gyur nas/ / rab tu sngags pa'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa las/ /nye bar bskrun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/

/bstod bya'i yon tan bdag la rdzogs gyur cig /gang gis tshul 'dis rtag tu bstod byed na/ /de yi rgyud la lha mo de dag gi /ye shes gzigs pa'i dam pa 'jug gyur cing*/ /phyogs rnams kun la rtag tu rgyal bar 'gyur/ / bstod tshig 'di ni blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang pos me sbrul nag pa'i zla ba yi/ /tshes bcu'i nyin par mi dbang ga (《 zha 》《 lu 》 go ) pe la'i/ /pho brang chen po legs par sbyar ba'o/ /lha mo lnga'i bstod pa ste gsum pa'o// //༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung | | rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid mchog /dung dang kunda'i mdog dang mtshungs | | so sor 'brang mar phyag 'tshal bstod/ kha dog nag mo mi bzad 'jigs | | rngam zhing zhal 'gyur khro bag can/ /gdul dka'i 'byung po yang dag 'dul/ /rdo rje khro mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo ye shes las byung che/ / gser gyi 'od ltar rab 'bar ba'i/ /rma bya che la rab dad pas/ /rig pa'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /padma kha bye'i zhal mnga' ma/ /zhal mdzes ma la spyan yangs shing*/ /padma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i/ /'gro ba'i mar gyur phyag 'tshal bstod | | mthing kha mdzes pa'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis sgeg ma/ /dug rnams 'joms par byed pa mo/ /sku mdzes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs skyong rnams la bstod pa ni/ gzi brjid ldan zhing dpal dang ldan/ /sde chen stobs kyang che ba ste/ /kun nas rang phyogs legs skyong ba'i | | phyogs skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glang chen sa srung bu la ni/ / rol pas bzhugs pa'i gser mdog can/ /rdo rje 'chang ba lha yi rje/ /brgya byin la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par bsgyings pa'i ma he la/ /mnyam par gnas pa añdza'i mdog /be con 'chang ba ma mo'i rje/

/gshin rje la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu srin la gnas chu shel mdog /nor bu dang bcas gdengs kas brgyan | | sbrul zhags 'dzin pa klu yi rje/ /chu yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rta mchog gzhon pa gser mdog can/ /nor bus mtshan pa'i dbyug to dang*/ / ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin rje/ /lus ngan po la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyu mchog la gnas 'jigs chen po/ /phyugs bdag chen po kunda'i mdog /rtse gsum 'chang ba 'byung po'i rje/ /dbang ldan la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /ra skyes zhon cing ches dmar ba/ /mchog sbyin dbyu gu bgrang phreng dang*/ /gunde 'dzin pa drang srong rje/ / me yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gad rgyangs sgrogs pa'i ro langs la/ /brtan par gnas pa char sprin mdog /ral gri 'chang ba srin po'i rje/ /bden bral la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu rtsen pa'i ri dwags kyi/ /bzhon pa la gnas margad mdog | ba dan 'dzin pa rig 'dzin rje/ /rlung gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po la gnas pa/ /gser mdog gdong bzhi padma dang*/ /bgrang phreng gunde glegs bam 'dzin/ /skye rgu'i mes po la phyag 'tshal/ /phag la zhon cing brtan par gnas/ /shin tu 'bar ba'i gser mdog can/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin/ /skye rgu'i ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gza' dang rgyu skar rnams la bstod pa ni/ rgyu skar khrod na legs rgyu zhing*/ /skye rgu 'grib dang 'phel ba dang*/ /bde sdug legs nyes ston mdzad pa'i/ /gza' chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /li khri'i mdog mtshungs rab mdzes shing*/ /shing rta'i dkyil (《 zha 》 steng ) na nyi dkyil bzhugs/ /padma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin/ /gzi brjid mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal/ /kunda ltar dkar zla ba ni/ /bsil zer byed pa'i dbus na bzhugs/ /ku mu ta yi sdong bu 'dzin/ /zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// mig dmar padma rā ga'i mdog /ra skyes zhon zhing khro tshul can/ /gri gug dang ni mi mgo 'dzin/

/mthu chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gza' lhag margad ltar ljang zhing | | padma la gnas zhi ba'i sku/ /mdzes shing rab sgeg mda' gzhu 'dzin/ / bde mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong phur bu gser mdog can/ /glang chen steng na rol pas bzhugs/ /bgrang phreng ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin/ /thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pa sangs gangs ri'i mdog mtshungs pa/ /padma la gnas bzhad pa'i zhal/ /shel phreng dang ni ril ba 'dzin/ /phan mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spen pa mig sman ltar gnag cing*/ /lto 'phye la zhon 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phreng ba dang ni dbyu gu 'dzin/ /mthu chen de la phyag 'tshal lo// lha min dbang po sgra gcan ni/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs chen po/ /phyag gnyis nyi ma zla ba 'dzin/ /stobs chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tog ni brag ri'i gdan la bzhugs/ kha dog skya bsangs drag po'i gzugs/ /sbrul zhags dang ni ral gri 'dzin/ /gtum chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon gyi legs spyad las grub cing*/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /rang rang phyogs dang dus skyong ba'i | | rgyu skar rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dag shar gyi phyogs gnas pa'i | | smin drug dang ni snar ma dang*/ /mgo lag nam so rgyal skag la/ / mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho yi phyogs na 'khod pa yi/ /mchu dang gre dbo me bzhi dang*/ nag pa sa ri sa ga la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo | | gang dag nub kyi phyogs gnas pa'i/ /lha mtshams snron snrubs chu stod dang | | chu smad byi bzhin gro bzhin la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang phyogs gnas pa'i mon gre dang*/ /mon gru khrums stod khrums smad dang*/ / nam gru tha skar bra nye la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi la bstod pa ni/ rgyal po chen po grags dang ldan/ /phyogs bzhi skyong zhing dgra rnams 'joms/ /sde dang rdzu 'phrul stobs che ba'i/

/rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /margad mdog mtshungs pi wang 'dzin | | dri za rnams la dbang mdzad pa/ /yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo// dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bum rnams la dbang sgyur ba/ /'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar ser sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la mnga' mdzad pa/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde dpon chen po gser mdog can | | be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin rnams la dbang sgyur ba/ / rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo// //lha mo lnga'i bstod pa ni/ slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa'i bsrung ba'i cho ga na bzhugs la/ lhag ma ni 'phags pas sbyar ba'o/ /'jig rten pa'i bstod pa dang bcas pa ste bzhi pa'o// //oṃ kārti kā/ ro hi ṇi/ mri ga shi raḥ ard+ra/ pu narba su/ pu ṣya/ ashle ṣā/ ma ghā/ pūrba phalgu ṇi/ utta ra phalgu ṇi/ hastā/ tsi trā/ swasti/ bi shākhā/ a nu rā ngha/ dzyeṣṭha mū la pūrba ṣa ḍha/ utta ra ṣa ḍha/ shra ba ṇā/ a bhi dzi ta/ ngha niṣṭhaḥ sha trā bhī ṣa | pūrba bha dra pa dā/ urta ra bha dra pa dā/ re wa tī/ a swi ni/ bha ra ṇī/ ming gi tshig 'di dag gi thog mar oṃ dang*/ mthar swā hā sbyar bas/ sngags kyi tshig tu 'gyur ro || || ༄༅/ /phyogs kyi gtor ma bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /de nas phyogs kyi gtor ma gtong ba'i phyir/ shar phyogs nas yul 'khor srung*/ 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /syādya the dan/ nghā ri ṇi/ nghā ri ṇi/ pra nghānsa/ ni bhañdza ni/ pra bhañdza ni | bi ngha ma ni/ kiṃ pu ru ṣe/ sha ka le/ sā ra the/ shū la nghā ri ṇe/ shū la dha re/ shungngha tsa ra ṇe/ gho ṣa ba te/ shā rā gre/ shānti/ che ge mo shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ /'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/

/gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*/ /gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod | | de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*/ /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo shar phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya'o | | syādya the dan/ a khe/ na khe/ bi na khe/ bandhe/ ba ra ṇe/ tsa pa le ba khe/ ba kha ne/ a khe le/ na khi ne/ ba hu le bha gebha ganda le/ ba she ba sha ba ni swā hā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gi ming dang*/ stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo'i gdon thams cad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig swā hā/ lho phyogs nas 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /syādya the dan/ shānti/ shā ra ba ti/ kānti/ kā ra wa ti/ kiṃ ka si/ kīṅka ra ti/ kimpa ti/ dhā ra ṇi/ bardha ni/ bhū mi nghā ra ṇi/ hi ma ba ti/ dzyo tishtsa ra ṇe/ mā lā gri/ che ge mo lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*/ /gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*/ /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyi kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo lho phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ syādya the dan/ kha kha kha me/ kha la ne/ kha lo me/ kha ra li/ kha ra li/ ka ra khe/ ka shi ne/ ka ra te/ ka le/ ka mā ni/ bi ngha le/ bi dhe ya sha ba ti sha mi/ sha ma ni swā hā/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po'i ming dang*/ stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/

byin gyis che ge mo'i gdon dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ de nas nub phyogs su mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /syādya the dan/ parṇi ba rā gre/ ba la ba ti/ ba li ni/ bi sha ∶me/ bi ba shi(《

zha 》 be bhi ma si ) sā ga re/ khā rī ka pi le/ tsaṇḍā li/ nā ra dza ni/ bi nghā ri ni/ balku ma ti/ a tsa li/ nub phyogs su che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ / 'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*/ / 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*/ / gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*/ /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig/che ge mo nub phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ syādya the dan/ kra ga ye/ kra ga she kra ga se/ kru sha me | kru ke krukkha me/ kru ge a ga le/ na ga le/ sa ma ga le/ ku hu me hu me/ a la ke ka la ke i ri mi re nghe re/ a ru ga ba ti swā hā/ rgyal po chen po'i mig mi bzang gi ming dang*/ stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo dge bar gyur cig swā hā/ /de nas byang phyogs su rnam thos kyi bu 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /syādya the dan/ kharge kharge/ khargarbhre/ bi tsakṣa ni/ tsakra rā dza ne/ tsand+re/ tsa pa le/ bhī ma parpa te/ kha rā gre ku ṭi la ka rā gre/ e kākshi brka ba ti/ sā ram̐ ga ba ti/ tsi tra kānti/ che ge mo byang phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang | | 'jig rten skyong ba dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang | | 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang | | gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyugs stobs kyis kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig che ge mo byang phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ /de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/

syādya the dan/ singnghe su singnghe/ a re/ a ra ṇe/ ba le/ ma hā ba le/ dzaṃ bhe/ dza ṭi le/ a kha ne/ ma kha ne/ kha kha ne/ kha raṭṭe | ha ri piṅga le/ ti miṅgi le/ ti miṅgi le swā hā/ bdag gis sngags kyi tshig rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i ming dang stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo dge bar gyur cig swā hā/ syādya the dan/ brahme brahma gho ṣe/ brahme swa re/ badzre badzra gho ṣe/ badzra ngha re/ te sā re/ a tsa le/ a ra ṇe/ i sha ne/ a rā ṇi te/ shū re/ ba rā gra/ prā pa te/ sā ra ba te | che ge mo phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og rnams su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā | tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba (《 zha 》 dang ) dbang phyug che | | gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang | | bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*/ /gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*/ /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*/ / nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo phyogs mtshams thams cad dang | steng dang 'og rnams su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ syādya the dan/ a sam̐ ge khad ga ba te/ ba la ba te/ ba la nirgho ṣe/ shū re shū ra ngha re/ badzra ga me/ badzra ngha re/ st+wambhe/∶dzambhe ḍi ḍha (《 zha 》 rti ḍḍa ) sā re/ bi ra dze/ bi gha se/ ba rā gra prā pa te/ a ra ṇe/ ngharma yutte/∶de shi bi ghuṣte(《 zha 》 dhi shi bhi gha ṣta ) / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang*/ stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā | zhes brjod cing phyogs phyogs su rol mo'i sgra yang bya'o/ /phyogs kyi gtor ma ste lnga pa'o// //༄༅/ /gza' skar gyi gtor ma bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /gza' dang rgyu skar la mchod cing gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/

/gza' gang dag rgyu skar rnams kyi khrod na rgyu zhing 'grib pa dang*/ 'phel ba dang*/ bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ lo legs pa dang*/ lo nyes pa dag kyang ston pa rnams 'di lta ste/ gza' nyi ma dang*/ gza' zla ba dang | gza' phur bu dang*/ gza' pa wa sangs dang*/ gza' spen pa dang*/ gza' mig dmar dang*/ gza' lhag pa dang*/ gza' lha min dbang po sgra can dang | gza' du ba mjug rings so/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ /de ltar phyogs na bdun bdun no/ /skar ma gza' bdun de bzhin te/ /rdzu 'phrul che zhing dka' thub che/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang*/ /sum cu rtsa bdun tshang ba dag/ 'char ba dang ni nub pa na/ /'khor lo mtshon cha bzhin du rgyu/ /'jig rten du ni zad 'phel byed/ /gzi che rdzu 'phrul chen po dag /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis su | | rig sngags rjes su yi rang byos/ /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig rgyu skar gang dag nam mkha' la rgyu zhing snang bar byed pa rnams 'di lta ste/ smin drug dang ni snar ma dang*/ /mgo dang lag dang nam so dang*/ /rgyal ni bkra shis phun gsum tshogs/ /de bzhin skag ste bdun pa yin/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni/ shar gyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag shar phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig mchu ni mi mdza' 'joms pa dang*/ /de bzhin gre dang dbo gnyis dang | | me bzhin nag pa sa ri dang*/ /sa ga ste ni bdun pa yin/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni lho phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag lho phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig

ston brgya mthong bar shog shig lha mtshams gzi brjid chen po dang*/ /de bzhin snron dang snrubs dang ni/ /chu stod dang ni chu smad dang*/ /de ltar byi bzhin gro bzhin dang*// de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni nub phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag nub phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig mon gru dang ni mon gre dang*/ /de bzhin khrums stod khrums smad dang*/ /nam gru dang ni tha skar dang*/ /bra nye ste ni bdun pa yin// de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni/ byang phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag byang phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig gza' skar gyi gtor ma dang gsol ba btab pa ste drug pa'o// //de nas sman dang 'bras bus brgyan pa'i dkar gtor gnyis dang*/ dmar gtor lnga bshams nas dkar gtor dang po byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i lam dang*/ lam ma yin pa na gnas pa bzhi yod de/ de dag kyang gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ bkra shis ldan dang | kun bshes dang*/ gang po dang*/ dga' ba'i dpal rnams te/ gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo | | chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ me'i 'jigs pa dang*/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang | mi'i 'jigs pa dang*/ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis ldan dang*/ kun bshes dang*/ gang po dang | dga' ba'i dpal la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod nas gtor ma/ na ma sarba ta thā ga tas phul la yang 'di skad ces/ 'das pa dang

| ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang | yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig dkar gtor gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad ces/ lag na rdo rje'i bu pho lag myur zhes bya ba/ grong khyer khor yug ces bya ba na gnas pa yod de/ gang de'i ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni des srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob par byed/ yongs su 'dzin par byed/ chad pa bzlog par byed/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ lag na rdo rje'i bu pho lag myur la gsol lo/ / gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad ces/ srin mo chen mo bcu bzhi yod de/ de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa na yang srung srung*/ bltams pa'i tshe na yang srung srung*/ bltams zin pa'i 'og tu yang srung srung*/ sku 'khrungs pa na yang srung srung ste/ bcu bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ stobs ldan dang*/ dri ma med dang*/ sgra chen dang*/ rab gnyen dang | 'jigs byed ma dang*/ 'dzam bu mgrin dang*/ mchog len dang*/ bla ma dang | grags ma dang*/ rmad grags dang*/ 'thab dga' ma dang*/ rtse mo dga' dang | sa 'dzin dang*/ 'thab 'jug go /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni/ de dag gis bsrung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin par byed/ zhi ba dang legs su 'gyur bar byed do/

/de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir de dag la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod la gtor ma phul la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /'das pa dang*/∶ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyur cig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur pa dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig(《 zha 》 sogs 'dre/ ) yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad ces/ srin mo brgyad yod de/ de dag ni skyes pa dang*/ bud med de dag gnyid log kyang rung*/ ma log kyang rung ste/ gzi brjid 'phrog par byed do/ / de dag gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rā dang*/ thub med dang*/ ngan slob dang*/ phra ma can dang*/ bran mo dmar mo dang*/ rab chen dang*/ mig bzang dang*/ brgyad pa ste 'jigs byed do/ /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang chad pa bzlog par byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir de dag la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod la gtor ma phul la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis zhig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad ces srin mo bdun yod de/ de dag ni khrag gi dri mnam nas dpag tshad brgyar yang rgyug go/ de dag kyang gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ gzi brjid mchog dang*/ dga' brtsegs dang | sna tshogs sbyin spang dang*/ bran mo dkar mo bzang dang*/ 'jug 'dod dang | grong khyer khor yug dang*/ bdun pa ste ri srung ngo*/

/gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed do/ /yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang chad pa bzlog par byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir de dag la gsol lo | | gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod la gtor ma phul la 'di skad ces/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor cig byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad ces/ srin mo chen mo nag mo zhes bya ba bu stong yod pa/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa mtshan gcig gis dpag tshad brgyad khrir phyin pa cig yod de | gang de'i ming shes pa dang rus shes pa de la ∶ni de dag gis (《 zha 》 des ) srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang chad pa bzlog par byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya'i phyir de dag la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad ces/ srin mo chen mo lnga gnod sbyin 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun dang*/ lhan cig tu 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la srung zhing skyob par byed de/ de dag kyang gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rtag tu myos dang | rjes su myos dang*/ stobs kyis rgyags dang*/ 'od ma'i sbubs dang*/ lnga pa ste 'byor ldan no/

/gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ chad pa bzlog pa dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang chad pa zlog par byed do | | de bas na bdag gis ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir srin mo lnga po gnod sbyin 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun dang bcas pa de dag la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod la gtor ma phul la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tadya thā/ bi mu de/ bī ti de/ pi tsa ra de/ bi ga ra de/ ka ra ḍi/ ka ra bā ri/ swa ri/ ma nghu ra ghoṣte/ sha ta ha ni ta/ bha shi ta ghe | ag ke nag ke bi ka ḍi tā/ bi ku ḍi te/ bi ra dze/ bi gaṣta bi de/ bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod nas rol mo'i sgra yang bya'o/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa'i gtor ma ste bdun pa'o// //༄༅/ /byur bsal ba bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i sngon du byur bsal ba'i phyir/ skyes pa'am bud med gdugs gcig smyung bar bgyis pa/ rab tu bkrus pa shin tu brgyan pa des/ dog sa la me tog gi sil ma bkram ste/ spos sna tshogs kyis bdug la/ seng ldeng dang*/ rgya shugs rigs gnyis kyi zhugs bus la/ sa bon thams cad phyogs bzhir gtor bar bgyi/ zhugs kyi nang du yang gtor bar bgyi | rtsa ba thams cad dang*/ me tog thams cad tshon skud sna tshogs la brgyus te ral gri'am/ mdung rtse gsum pa'am/ mdung ngam mda' la gdags par bgyi'o | | spos chab sna tshogs sbyar te/ bum pa chen po'i nang du blugs la gang la byad kyis phog pa de skud pa des bcings te/ bum pa'i chab kyis bkru bar bgyi'o | | skud pa yang mtshon gyis bcad de/ zhugs kyi nang du dor ro/ /stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i gzungs 'di yang brjod par bya'o/ /gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*/ /tshangs dbang dang ni 'jig rten skyong*/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*/ /de dag mthu dang gzi brjid kyis/ /che ge mo yi byad stems las/ /rnam pa thams cad chad gyur cig /ces brjod cing bcings pa'i tshon skud rnams bcad par bya'o// de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mes sreg cing*/ rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang*/ / me yis bud shing sreg pa dang*/ /rlung gis sprin rnams gtor ba dang*/ /nyi mas nags tshal skems byed pa/ /bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ /byad ltems las rnams tshig gyur cig /spos dang me tog sna tshogs kyis/ /sdig pa thams cad nges par bsal/ /tadya thā/ hu me hu me/ ka kha li/ ka kha li/ kha ra le/ dzu hī ni/ dza ba li/ ga ra ge ha ra ge ha ra gi(《 zha 》 ni/ ) shā ba ri/ shānta/ pra shānt-i swā hā | nghā pa ni swā hā/ pra dhā ba ni swā hā/ gandharbha swā hā/

pa lam̐ gi ni swā hā/ sarba kā khorda | tstshe da ni swā hā/ i mairyant+ra sa der/ ma ma sarba sa tā nañtsa/ sarba kā khorda/ be da do ṣa ti/ mant+ra pi ṣa pra yo ga sarba dairbaishtshe di tra/ be di tā dzi ta pa ra dzi ta swā hā/ zhes bsreg pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa byas nas thal ba lam gyi bzhi mdor dor ro/ /byur bsal ba ste brgyad pa'o// //༄༅/ /dug dbyung ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*/ /rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang*/ /dgra bcom dag gi mthu dag dang*/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*/ /shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang*/ /maung gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang | | ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni/ /'od srungs sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// ko'u ḍi n+ya'i sngar thob dang*/ /kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang*/ /tshangs pa lha yi byams pa dang*/ /brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang*/ /dbang phyug chen po'i stobs dag dang*/ /sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang*/ /'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis | | bdag gi dug ni dug med shog /dug med dug rnams 'jig byed shog | syādya the dan/ ha ri gi shi na ki li/ a he re/ a ma re/ aṇḍa re/ paṇḍa re | ka ṭa ke ke yū re/ ha se ha se ha se/ kha se kha se kha se kha ram̐ ge ma ru ga ha ṇe swā hā/ mu mukṣa swā hā/ hi le swā hā/ mi le swā hā/ 'bras dang rma dang shu ba dang*// g.yan pa dang ni 'brum bu dang*/ /lhog pa dang ni g.ya' ba ni/ /bdun pa lags te rab tu bcom/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan chos ni dug mi mnga'/ /chos kyi gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/

/de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan dge 'dun dug mi mnga'/ /dge 'dun gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /sa ni dug gi ma yin te/ /sa ni dug gi pha yang yin/ /chu ni dug gi ma yin te/ /chu ni dug gi pha yang yin/ /me ni dug gi ma yin te/ /me ni dug gi pha yang yin/ /rlung ni dug gi ma yin te/ /rlung ni dug gi pha yang yin | | bden pa'i bden tshig de dag gis/ /bdag gi dug ni dug med shog/dug ni 'byung ba'i nang du song gang ba'i snod du dug song shig swā hā/ dug dbyung ba ste dgu pa'o// // ༈ na mo bungnghā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na ma ssam̐ ghā ya/ na maḥsu warṇa a ba bha sa sya ma yūr rā dzñe/ na mo ma hā ma yū rā ya bidyā rā dzñe/ tadya thā/ siddhe su saddhe/ mo tsa ni/ mo kṣa ni/ mukte/ bi mukte/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ aṇḍa re/ paṇḍa re/ maṅga lye/ maṃ ga lye/ hi ra n+yai/ hi ra ṇya garbhe/ ratne/ ratna garbhai/ bha dre su bha dre/ sa manta bha dre/ shrī bha dre/ sarba artha sā ngha ni/ pa ra mārtha sā dha ni/ sarba a nartha pra ba ngha ni/ sarba maṃ ga la sā ngha ni/ sarba a maṅga la sā ngha ni/ ya sho ba ti/ ma na si/ mā na si/ ma hā mā na sī/ a tsaryu te/ atbhu te/ ad dyaṃ bhu te/ mukte/ bi mukte/ mo tsa ni/ mo shakṣa ni/ bra hme/ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ bi ma le/ amṛ te/ a mṛ ta warṣa ni/ a ma re/ a ma ra ṇi/ brahme brahma swa re/ pūrṇ+ṇe pū?rṇ+ṇa ma no ra the/ a mṛ te/ a mṛ ta sañdzī wa ni/ shrī bha dre/ tsand+re tsand+ra pra bhe dre/ sūrye sūrya kānte/ bī ta bha ye/ sarba su warṇ+ṇe/ su warṇ+ṇa pra bhe/ brahma gho ṣe/ brahma dzuṣte/ sarba tra/ a pra ti ha te swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag dge ba dang*/ bdag la srung bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /bdag lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cigaston brgya mthong bar gyur cig tadya thā/ hu tsi shu tsi ghu tsi mu tsi swā hā/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo/

/rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /dgra bcom pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ / phyir mi 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo | | bden par smra ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /tshangs pa'i me dbal gyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /dbang po'i rdo rjai'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ khyab 'jug gi 'khor los dug bcom mo/ /∶gshin rje'i be con gyis dug bcom mo/(《 zha 》 me lha'i dbal gyi dug bcom mo/ ) /chu lha'i zhags pas dug bcom mo/ /lha ma yin gyi sgyus dug bcom mo/ /klu'i rigs sngags kyis dug bcom mo/ /drag po'i mdung rtses dug bcom mo/ /skem byed kyi mdung thung gis dug bcom mo/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mos dug bcom mo/ / dug nges par bcom mo/ /dug sa'i nang du song zhig bdag dug thams cad dang | be'u lta bu'i dug dang*/ ha la ha la'i dug dang*/ nag po brtsegs pa'i dug dang*/ mche ba'i dug dang*/ rtsa ba'i dug dang*/ kha zas kyi dug dang*/ phye ma'i dug dang*/ lta ba'i dug dang*/ glog gi dug dang*/ sprin gyi dug dang*/ sbrul dang | byi ba dang*/ srin bu ki ta dang*/ lu ta dang*/ ka na bha dang*/ sbal pa dang*/ sbrang bu dang*/ bung ba dang*/ pa ti ri dang*/ tre ma pu ka dang*/ tre la ta'i dug dang*/ mi'i dug dang*/ sdig pa'i dug dang*/ mi ma yin pa'i dug dang*/ dogs pa'i dug dang*/ sman pa'i dug dang*/ rigs sngags kyi dug las bde legs su gyur cig dug thams cad las bdag bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ dug dbyung ba gnyis pa ste bcu pa'o// //༈ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las so/ /dge 'dun mu stegs byed las rgyal/ /dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal | | lha min zla ba las ni rgyal/

/nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni sprin las rab tu rgyal/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas | | sa yang bden par gnas pa lags/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden | | bden pa rgyal 'gyur brdzun ma lags/ /syādya the dan/ a mṛ te/ a gra puṣbe/ ba hu pha le/ ni bā ra ṇi/ sarba artha sā ngha ni/ a pa rā dzi te/ ba ra ṭe dhā ra ṇi/ gu hyā brta te/ gau ta me/ gu gu ta ma ti/ dzambha ni swā hā/ pra dzambha ni sā hā/ ba la pra bhañdza ni swā hā/ dza ye swā hā/ bi dza ye swā hā/ dza ya bi dza ye swā hā/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu pham/ /phyir rgol ba ni kun las rgyal swā hā/ rgyal bar byed pa ste bcu gcig pa'o// //༄༅/ /dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i sdom tshig bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ /sngon 'gro sbyangs nas mtshams gcod bya/ /gnas dang mchod pa byin phab nas/ /bdag bskyed mchod nas bzlas pa bya/ /bum pa gsal gdab mchod nas bzla/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas byin gyis brlab/ /mchod bstod gtor ma rnams bdun gtang*/ /gtso mo'i bum steng mchod rten ni/ /ming byang bcas la kun du dang*/ /dūr ba sngags dang bcas pas mchod/ /phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma phyogs nas gtong*/ /so so'i gtor bcas lha gzhan la/ /gsol ba btab nas slar yang mchod/ /byur bsal dug dbyung rnam gnyis bya/ /rgyal bar byed pas bslang nas ni/ /gos sar rgyan gyis brgyan byas nas/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab/ /spyi bor bum bzhag sor 'brang gi /gzungs ring gnyis dang sngags gzhan gyis/ / dbang bskur nas ni sngags kyis bsrung*/ /srung 'khor gdags shing rdo rjes bsrung | | bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrungs byas nas/ /sman nam zas la bden pa'i stobs/ /brjod nas mnga' dbul shis pa brjod/ /yon blang mchod bstod gshegs su gsol/

/dam pas bskul nas 'phags pas sbyar// //༄༅/ /dbang bskur ba dngos bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇḍal phul la/ me tog bzung nas 'di skad ces/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ba re/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rig pa'i dbang bskur ba rdo rje'i cho ga chen po'i phyag rgyas btab pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a nghiṣṭhi te badzra swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog dang spos thogs la/ 'di la dbang bskur du gsol zhes 'don pa bsgyur la/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas spyi bor bum pa bzhag la 'di skad ces/ na mo bungnghā ya/ na mo ngharm+mā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ na mo na maḥsarba bungngha bo nghi sa twa ngharma saṃ ghe bhyaḥ tadya thā/ oṃ bi pu la bi pu la garbhe/ bi pu la | bi ma le/ bi pu la garbhe/ bi ma le/ dza ya garbhe/ badzra dzwā lā garbhe/ ga ti ga ha ne ga ga na bi sho ngha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho ngha ne/ oṃ gu ṇa ba ti/ ga ga na pi tsā ri ṇi | ga ga ri ṇi/ gi gi gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ ga ma ri ga ma ri/ ga ha ga ha/ garga ri garga ri/ ga ga ri/ ga ga ri/ gambha ri gambha ri/ ga bhe/ ga bhi/ ga bhi/ ga hi ga hi/ ga ma ni ga ma ni/ ga ri ga ri/ gu bha gu bha/ gu ha gu ha/ gu ru gu ru | gu ru ṇi/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsa le tsa le/ mu tse le/ mu tse le/ dza ye bi dza ye/ sarba bha ya/ bi ga te/satwa sarba garbha saṃ rakṣa ṇi/ si ri si ri/ bhi ri bh-i ri/ mi ri mi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ghi ri ghi ri/ ghi ri ghi ri sa manta parṣa ṇi/ bha ga wa tī/ satwā nā ya ki sa manta nā ya ki sarba sha trūṃ pra marda ni/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ/ sarba sa twāñtsa sarba dā/ sarba bha ye bhya: sarba u pa dra be bhya: sarba bya nghi bhyashtsa/ tsi ri tsi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ nghi ri nghi ri/ bi ga ta/ ā wa ra ṇe bi sho ngha ne/

bi bi ngha/ ā ba ra ṇa/ bi nā sha ni/ mu ri mu ri/ mu tsi mu tsi/ mu li mu li/ tsi li tsi li/ ki li ki li/ mi li mi li/ ka ma le/ bi ma le/ dza ye bi dza ye/ bi dza yā ba he/ dza ya wa ti/ bi she ṣa ba ti/ bha ga ba tī ma hā bidyā ratna ma ku ṭa mā la ngha ri/ bī hu bi bi nghā bi tsi tra bi shwa ngha ri ṇi/ bha ga wa tī ma hā bidyā de wī/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sa pa ri wā ra/ sarba sa twāñtsa | sa manta sarba tra/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho ngha ni/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba sa twāñtsa/ anā tha/ na tra yā/ na sha ra ṇa/ na pa ra ya ṇa na/ pa ri mo tsa ya sarba duḥ khebhyaḥ tsaṇḍe tsaṇḍe/ tsaṇḍe tsaṇḍe/ tsaṇḍi ṇitsaṇḍi ṇi/ be ga wa ti/ sarba duṣtā ni bā ra ṇi/ bi dza ya bā hi ni/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tu ru tu ru/ ā yuḥpā li ni/ su ra ba ra pra ma tha ni/ sarba de wa ga ṇa pū dzi ti/ tsi ri tsi ri/ nghi ri nghi ri/ sa manta a wa lo ki te/ pra bhe pra bhe/ su pra bhe/ su pra bha/ bi shungnghe/ sarba pā pa bi shungnghe/ sarba pā pa bi sho ngha ni/ nghu ru nghu ru/ ngha ra ṇi/ ngha re ngha re/ ngha ra/ su mu su mu/ su mu su mu/ mu su mu su/ ru ru tsa le tsā la ya/ sarba duṣtanā shāshsha ra ṇa bha wa tu māṃ/ ā sha sū ra ya māṃ/ shrī wa su ngha ri/ dza ya ka ma le/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi/ ba ra da/ aṃ ku she oṃ padma bi shungnghe/ sho ngha ya sho ngha ya/ shungnghe shungnghe/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ maṃ ga la bi shungnghe/ pa bi tra mu khi khaḍgi ni/ khaḍgi ni/ kha ra kha ra | dzwa li ta/ shi kha re/ sa manta a ba lo ki ta pra bhe/ su pra bi shuddhe/ sa manta pra sā ri ta/ a bā bha si ta shuddha/ dzwa la dzwa la/ sarba de wa ga ṇa/ gra ha/ na kṣa tra/ sa ma ā karṣa ṇi/ satya pra ti oṃ hrī trām̐ tā ra tā ra/ tā ra ya tā ra ya māṃ/ bha ga wa tī sarba satwa shtsa/ na ga bya ba lo ki ti/ la hu la hu/ hu lu hu lu/ hu du hu du/ tu ru tu ru

| ki ṇi ki ṇi/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi/ hu ṇi hu ṇi/ sarba gra ha bakṣa ṇi/ piṃ ga la piṃ ga le/ mu tsu mu tsu/ tsu mu tsu mu/ su bi tsa re/ ta ra ta ra/ na ga bya ba lo ki ni/ tā ra ya māṃ | sarba sa twañtsa/ bha ga wa tī/ aṣta ma hā tā ra ya bha ye bhyaḥ sarba tra sa manta sarba di sha bandhe na/ badzra prā kā ra/ badzra pā sha bandhe na tsa/ badzra dzwā lā bi shuddhe/ bhu ri bhu ri | dha ra dha ra/ ti ri ti ri/ tu ru tu ru/ bha ga wa tī/ garbha bi shuddhe/ garbha saṃ sho dha ni/ ku kṣi/ saṃ pū ra ṇi/ dzwa la dzwa la/ tsa la tsa la/ dzwā li ni dzwā li ni/ barṣa tu de wa sa mantā she ya u da ke ta a mṛ ta barṣa ṇ-i de wa tā a ba tā ra ṇi/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na/ a mṛ ta ba ra pu ṣe/ rakṣa rakṣa bha ga wa tī māṃ/ sarba tra/ sarba dhā/ sarba bha ye bhyaḥ sarba u pa dra be bhyaḥ sarba u pa sarg+ge bhyaḥ sarba bya dhi bhyaḥ sarba duṣtāṃ bhyaḥya ba ti bhyaḥ sarba ki li ki la ha/ bi gra ha bi bā dā/ du pna/ durni matte/ a maṃ ga la/ pā pa bi sho dha ni/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa/ na ga bi dā ra ṇi/ ba la ba la/ ba la ba ti dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ dza ya tu māṃ/ sarba tā sarba kā le/ sidhyantu me i yaṃ ma hā bidya/ sā dha ya maṇḍa laṃ/ sā dha ya mant+ra na

| ghā ta ya bighnā na/ dza ya dza ya/ singnghyi singnghyi/ singnghya singnghya/ bungnghya bungnghya/ su tsa ya sū tsa ya | pū ra ya pū ra ya/ pū ra ṇi pū ra ṇi/ pū ra ya me a shān/ sarba bidyā uṅga ta murti/ dza yo a dhi/ dza ya bha ti na/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bha ga wa tī/ sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya | sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya shungnghe/ bya ba lo ka ra ya māṃ sa pa ri wā raṃ sarba satwashtsa aṣta ma hā bha ye bhyaḥ sarba ā shaṃ pa ri pū ra ya/ tra ya swā/ ma hā bha ye bhyaḥ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sarba ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni/ sa manta a ka ra maṇḍa la bi shuddhe | bi ga te bi ga ti/ bi ga ta ma le/ sarba ma la bi sho dha ni/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi/ sarba pā pa bi shuddhe/ ma la bi ga ti/ dza ya ba ti/ te dzo te dzo ba ti/ badzra badzra ba ti swā hā/ trai lo kya a dhiṣṭhi ta swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta murdha a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba bo dhi satwa a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba de wa tā a bi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga t-i hra da ya a dhiṣṭhi te swā hāsarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya siddhe swā hā/ int+ra int+ra bya ba lo ki te swā hā | brahme brahma dhu ṣi te swā hā/ biṣṇu na ma skri te swā hā/ ma he shwa ra bandha pū dzi te ye swā hā | badzra dha ra badzra pā ṇi ba la birya a dhiṣṭhā te swā hā/ dhṛ ta rāṣtā ya swā hā/ bi ru ṭa kā ya swā hā/ bi ru pakṣā ya swā hā/ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā/ tsa turma hā rā dzā na ma skri tā ya swā hā/ ya ma ye swā hā/ ya ma pū dzi ti na ma skri tā ya swā hā/ bā ru ṇā ya swā hā/ ma ru tā ya swā hā/ ma hā ma ru tā ya swā hā/ agna ye swā hā/ nā ga bya ba lo ki te ye swā hā | de wa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ nā ga ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ yakṣa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ya ma ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ rākṣa sa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ gandharba ga ṇe ཿswā hā/ a su ra ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ga ru ḍa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ kinni ra ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/

ma ho ra ga ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ma nu ṣye ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ a ma nu ṣye ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba gra he bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba bhū te bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba pre te bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba pi shā tse bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba unmā de bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba a pasmā re bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba kumbhaṇḍe bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba pū ta ne bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba ka ṭa pū ṭa ni bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba duṣta pra duṣte bhyaḥswā hā/ oṃ dhu ru dhu ru swā hā/ oṃ tu ru tu ru swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ oṃ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ oṃ ha na ha na sarba sha trūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba duṣtāṃ swā hā/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pra tyārti kā/ pratyaṃ mi trā nāṃ swā hā/ ye ma ma a hā ti ā she na te ṣāṃ sarba sha rī raṃ dzwā la ya dzwā la swā hā | sarba duṣtāṃ tsittā nāṃ swā hā/ dzwā li ta ye swā hā/ pra dzwā li tā ya swā hā/ badzra dzwā lā ya swā hā/ agni dzwā lā ya swā hā/ sa manta dzwā lā ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ pūrna bha drā ya swā hā/ ma hā kā lā swā hā/ ma tri ga ṇā ya swā hā/ yakṣa ṇi naṃ swā hā/ rākṣa si ni naṃ swā hā/ ā kā sha ma tṛ ṇaṃ swā hā/ sa mu dra ba si naṃ swā hā/ ra tṛ tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ dī ba tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ tri sandha tsa rā nāṃ swā hā/ be la tsa rā nāṃ swā hā/ a be la tsa rā nāṃ swā hā | garbha ha re bhyaḥswā hā/ garbha hi ri ṇi bhyaḥswā hā/ hu lu hu lu swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ swaḥswā hā/ bhuḥswā hā/ bhuḥwa swā hā/ oṃ bhurbhu waḥswā hā/ bi li bi li swā hā/ tsi ṭi tsi ṭi swā hā/ bi ṭi bi ṭi swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi swā hā/ agni swā hā/ te dzo wa yu swā hā/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/ mi li mi li swā hā/ si li si li swā hā/ buddhya buddhya swā hā | siddhya siddhya swā hā/ manḍa la bandhe swā hā/

sī mā bandhe swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi bandhe swā hā/ sarba sha trūṃ/ bhañdza ya bhañdza ya swā hā/ dzambha ya dzambha ya swā hā/ stambha ya stambha ya swā hā/ tstshinda tstshinda swā hā/ bhinda bhinda swā hā/ bhañdza bhañdza swā hā/ bandha bandha swā hā/ mo ha ya mo ha ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bi shuddhe swā hā/ sūrye swā hā/ sūrya bi shuddhe swā hā/ sho dha ni swā hā/ bi sho dha ni swā hā/ tsand+re tsand+re pa ri purṇa tsand+rai swā hā/ gra he bhyaḥswā hā/ nakṣa tre bhyaḥswā hā/ pi shā tse bhyaḥswā hā/ shi bi bhyaḥswā hā/ bi shwa bhyaḥswā hā/ shānti bhyaḥswā hā/ puṣtiṃ bhyaḥswā hā/ swasti ya ne bhyaḥswā hā/ garba dha re swā hā/ shi paṃ ka ri swā hā/ shaṃ ka ri swā hā/ shāntiṃ ka ri swā hā/ puṣtiṃ ka ri swā hā/ ba la bardha ne swā hā/ ba la bardhi ni ka ri swā hā/ shrī ka ri swā hā/ shrī bardhi ni swā hā/ shrī dzwā li ni swā hā/ mu tsi swā hā/ na mu tsi swā hā/ ma ru tsi swā hā/ be ga ba ti swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga te ∶mūrti ba ra bi ma le bha ga wa ti(《 zha 》 murte wirta | bhi ga ta bha ye sa me bha ga wa ti sarba paṃ/ ) / swa ti bha wa tu/ ma ma sarba sa twāñtsa swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni/ dha ri tsa la tsa la na/ bha ga wa ti/ bha ya bi ga te | bha ya ha ri ṇi/ bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ buddhi li buddhi li/ tsumbu li tsumbu li swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya dzaṣte swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ mu ni ba re/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ sarba sa twashtsa sarba ta thā ga ta/ sarba bidyā a bh-i ṣe kairma hā badzra ka tsa | mu dre te/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a dh-iṣṭhā na/ a dhiṣṭhī te badzre swā hā/ dbang bskur ba ste bcu gnyis pa'o// // ༈ tadya thā/ oṃ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ gi ri ba ti/ gu ṇa ba ti | ā kā sha ba ti/ ā kā sha bi shuddhe/ sarba pā pa bi ga te/

ā kā sha ga ga na ta le | ā kā sha bi tsā ri ṇi/ dzwā lī ta shi kha re/ ma ṇi mukti ka kha tsi ta mau li dha re/ su ke she me ke she su ṣa su ba ka tre/ su ne tre su barṇe/ su barṇa gau ri/ a tī te/ a nutpanne/ a nā ga te/ pratyutpanne na maḥsarbe ṣān/ buddha nān/ dzwa li ta te dza sā na/ buddhe su buddhe/ bha ga wa ti/ su rakṣa ni sukṣe me/ su pra bhe/ su da me/ su dānte/ ba re ba re warte/ bha ga wa ti/ bha dra ba ti/ bha dre/ su bha dre/ bi ma le/ dza ya bha dre/ pra tsaṇḍi tsaṇḍi/ pra tsaṇḍe*/ pra tsaṇḍe*/ badzra tsaṇḍe*/ ma hā tsaṇḍe*/ ma hā tsaṇḍe/ gau ri/ tsau ri | tsaṇḍī lī/ mā tāṃ gi brtsa si/ pukka si/ su ma ti/ sha ba ri/ shā ba ri/ shaṃ ka ri | dra mi ḍi/ drā mi ḍi/ rau tri ni/ sarba gra ha bi dā ri ṇi artha sā dha ni/ ha na ha na | sarba sha trūṃ/ da ha da ha/ sarba duṣtan/ pre ta pi shā tsa/ ḍā ki nī naṃ/ ma nu ṣyā/ a ma nu ṣyā nāñtsa/ pa tsa pa tsa hṛ da yan/ gdon ma rungs pa rnams kyi srog gzhom du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag gi sdig pa thams cad gzhig tu gsol/ gzhig tu gsol/ thams cad du 'jigs pa dang*/ gnod pa thams cad las bdag la bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ ma rungs pa thams cad bcing du gsol | sarba kalpi ṣa nā sha ni/ mārtaṇḍa/ mṛ tyu daṇḍa ni bā ra ni/ mā na na/ daṇḍa mā na ni/ ma hā mā ni ni/ ma hā bi ṇi ṭi/ tsa le tsa le/ tsi ṭi tsi ṭi/ bi ṭi bi ṭi/ ni ṭi ni ṭi/ ti ṭi ta ṭi/ na tu ṭi/ gau ri ṇi/ bī ri ni/ pra ba ra sa ma re/ tsaṇḍā lī/ mā tāṃ gi rundha si/ sa ra si/ brtsa si/ su ma ti/ pukka si/ sha ba ri/ shā ba ri/ shaṃ ka ri/ dra mi ḍi/ drā mi ḍi/ da ha ni/ pa tsa ni/ ma tha ni/ marda ni/ sa ra li/ sa ra le/ sa ra laṃ bhe/ hī na ma dhyoṅkriṣta/ bi dhā ra ṇi/ bi dhā ri ṇi/ ma hi le/ ma hā ma hi le/ ni ga ḍe/ ṇi ga ḍe/ bhañdze/ matti matti ni/ dānti tsakre/ tsakra bā gi ni/ dzwa le dzwa le/ dzwā le dzwā le/

dzwā la ni/ sha ba ri sha ba ri/ shā ba ri shā ba ri/ sarba byā dhi/ ha ra ṇ-i/ tsū ḍi tsū ḍi/ tsū ḍi ni tsū ḍi ni/ ma hā tsū ḍi ni/ ni mi ni mi/ ni mindha ri/ tri lo ka da ha ni/ tri lo ka ā lo ka kā ri/ trai dhā tu ka bya ba lo ki ni/ badzra pa ra shu pā sha mutka ra/ khaḍga/ shaṅkha/ tsakra/ tri shū la/ tsintā ma ṇi/ ma hā bidyā dhā ri ṇi/ bdag thams cad du gnas thams cad du gnas pa na ma rungs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ nad thams cad dang */ 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo/ /badzre badzre badzra ba ti/ badzra pā ṇi dha re/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ ki li ki li/ tsi li tsi li/ pi li pi li/ si li si li/ ba ra ba ra ba ra de/ sarba tra | dza ya labdhai swā hā/ sarba pā pa bi dā ri ṇi swā hā/ sarba tra sarba byā dhi ha ra ṇi swā hā | sarba tra sarba sha trūn bha ya ha ra ṇi swā hā/ sarba bha ra ṇi swā hā/ swa stirbha ba tu māṃ swā hā/ shāntiṃ ka ri swā hā/ puṣtiṃ ka ri swā hā/ ba la bardha ri ṇi swā hā/ dza ya tu/ dza ye dza ye/ dza ya ba ti/ ka ma le/ bi ma le/ bi pu le swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta mūrti swā hā | oṃ bhu ri ma hā shānti swā hā/ oṃ bhū ri bhū ri badzra ba ti/ sarba ta thā ga ta hra da ya pū ra ṇi/ ā yussandha ra ṇi/ ba la ba la ba la ba ti/ dza ya bi dzi ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dbang bskur ba'i gzungs phyi ma ste bcu gsum pa'o// //༈ bden pa dang bden pa'i mchog (《 zha 》 tshig ) gang gis/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa'i tshig bden pa rnams dang 'jig rten gyi tshig gi mchog dang | dge sbyong rnams kyi nang na dge sbyong skyid de ba zhes bya ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'jigs pa mi mnga' ba/ bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba ste/ mi skrag mi 'bros la 'jigs pa med cing

| (《 zha 》+ 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs par byed pa dang bral ba dang ) 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs par byed pa spangs pa/ skyi bung zhes byed pa med pa'o zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag par smra bas smra ba yin te/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis tshul khrims dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ dka' thub dang | tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa gang ci yang rung ba de dag gi nang na ni/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig gnas brtan rgyal po'i bu thu bo dang 'dra bar rab tu byung nas (《 zha 》+ yun ) ring du lon pa tshangs par spyod pa mngon par spyad pa rnams kyi mchog 'di lta ste/ dge slong kun shes kau ḍi n+ya dang*/ 'dod pa nyung ba dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa dang*/ chog shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs chen po dang*/ shes rab che ba dang | spobs pa che ba rnams kyi mchog sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang*/ rdzu 'phrul che ba dang | mthu che ba rnams kyi mchog maung gal gyi bu chen po dang*/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gags pa dang*/ mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye ba 'khor dang*/ chos smra ba rnams kyi mchog byams ma'i bu gang po dang*/ bslab pa la gus pa rnams kyi mchog sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ mal cha dang stan bsko ba rnams kyi mchog gyad bu nor dang*/ seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa rnams kyi mchog bha ra nghā dza bsod snyoms len dang*/ khyim pa dad pa bskyed pa rnams kyi mchog nag po chen po 'char ka dang*/ lha dang mis mchod pa rnams kyi mchog legs mthong gi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o/ / yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/

zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o/ /rgyal po'am/ chom rkun nam/ me'am/ chu'am | dgra'am/ mi mdza' ba'am/ lam du 'gro ba'am/ lam gol bar 'gro ba'am | gnyid log pa'am/ ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa thams cad las bsrung bar bya'o/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang pa med pa'am | rkang gnyis pa'am/ rkang bzhi pa'am/ rkang mangs sam/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes ∶med (《 zha 》 can ma yin ) pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o/ / yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'dus byas sam | 'dus ma byas kyi chos ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni | 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o | | bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ tshogs sam/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po 'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des | rgyal khams sam/ yul 'khor ram/ grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/ khyim mam/ nags sam/ zhing ngam/ nad pa 'di la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshams gcad par bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o | | gzi byin (《 zha 》 brjid ) 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngas/

'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug zad par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa dang | bshad pa dang*/ brjod pa'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrung ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //༈ nad pa'i zas dang*/ skom dang*/ sman rnams kyang rig sngags 'dis btab ste stsal bar bgyi'o/ /rdzogs sangs rnam par sangs rgyas tshe/ / 'jig rten skyong bas phyogs bzhi nas/ /snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su/ /bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang*/ /mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa/ /lha yi snod mchog de dang ni/ /bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams/ /ston pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa/ /bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis/ /lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra/ / blangs nas ston la rab phul ba/ /bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams/ /bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ /nad pa rnams kyi nad sel can/ /nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*/ /gtsur tor can gyi stobs rnams dang*/ /thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*/ /log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*/ /gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang*/ /'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /nad pa shar phyogs kha bstan la/ /sman rnams nye bar stsal bar bgyi/ /de yi tshe na rig sngags 'di/ / lag mthil bzhag ste klag par bgyi/ /syādya ya the dan/∶kha ṭe kha ṭe/ kha ṭe bi kha ṭe/(《

zha 》 kha ḍe kha ḍe kha ḍe bi kha ḍe/ tsa le tsi tsa le/ ) bi ma le/ bi laṃ be/ ba le/ ba la ba ti | tsand+re/ tsa ra ṇe/ a mṛ ta nirgho ṣe swā hā/ rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur | | bad kan las gyur 'dus las gyur/ /nad rnams thams cad rab bcom ste/ /bdag la rtag tu bde legs shog /bram ze rnams kyis bslus nas su | | shākya seng ge skyob pa la/ /dpal sbas kyis ni dug can gyi/ /bsod snyoms dag ni phul ba dang*/ /de las de ni blangs nas su/ /ston pas dug ni bsad nas gsol/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di yis su/ /zas ni bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /rnam par gzigs la lha gang dang*/ /gtsug tor can dang kun skyob dang*/ /log par dad pa sel ba dang*/ /stobs chen lha gang dad pa dang | | gser dang dpal ldan 'od srungs dang*/ /shākya yi ni seng ge la/ /rab dad lha yi dbang po dang*/ /tshangs dbang sum cu'i dbang phyug dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dag dang*/ /nor bu bzang dang dbang phyug che/ /srin mo nag mo chen mo dang*/ /de bzhin gdol ma gtum mo dag /me tog dang ni bdug pa dang*/ / bdag gi sbyin sreg 'di bzhes shig /de dag tshim zhing mchod gyur nas/ / bdag gi kha zas byang bar mdzod/ /zas lnga dag dang 'dres pa yang*/ /bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol/ kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*/ /zas de kun ni bza' bar bgyi/ /sa bon dag gi tshogs kun la/ /sa yi bcud ni zhugs pa yi/ kha zas 'dres pa thams cad kyang*/ /bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol/ /ji ltar skud pa bcad bsregs kyang*/ /de ltar bur yang slar 'byor pa/ /de ltar zas rnams 'dres pa yang*/ /ma 'dres par ni bdag la mdzod/ /syādya the dan/ kha kha me/ kha kha/ kha kha/ kha kha me/ shi me/ shi me/ shi hū me/ shi ma/ shi me swa sti swasti swasti swasti ma ma shīntaṃ/ sha rā gri/ kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*/ /ji ltar ma 'dres zas bzhin du/ /gang gis ji ltar skud bsregs pa/ /de 'dra'i bden pa mdzad du gsol/

/syādya the dan/ ka la ke ka la le/ ba la ni/ ka ru ta ā la ye | agne/ sam̐ krā ma ṇe swā hā/ /sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dang sangs rgyas gtsug tor can/ /bde gshegs kun skyob sangs rgyas log par dad sel dang | | gser thub 'od srungs shākya thub pa gau ta mya/ /bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /mi mchog bdun po de dag ni sku rnams la/ /me tog dag dang spos rnams kyis ni mchod par bgyi/ /lus dang ngag dang rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis ni/ /de dag rnams la skyabs su nye bar mchi bar bgyi/ / sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la/ /lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi/ /lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' 'gyur nas/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol// //༈ 'jig rten 'di'am yang na 'das pa dang*/ /mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa'ang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /mi yi mchog dang 'dir ni mtshungs pa med/ /de bas 'di ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs | | bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas/ /shes pas shākya thub de rab tu phye/ /bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus byas ma yin pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog | mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab bstan pa/ /ston pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag bsgrub pa/ /rdo rje lta bu mi gnyis lam mthong ba/ /ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ / bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing*/ /gang zag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni/ /drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs med pa/ /bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas shes gsungs | | de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'gyur te/ /zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhin/

/'di ni dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing | | gau ta ma yi bstan la 'jug byed pa/ /de dag thob nas bdud rtsi 'jug (《 zha 》 mchog ) thob ste/ /mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa/ /de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog | lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni/ /'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*/ /the tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs | | bden pa de yis 'dir ni mchog thob shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang*/ /sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed la/ /glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed cing*/ /de ltar de dag lta bas 'dzin mi byed/ /de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog | ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po sar btsugs pa/ /phyogs bzhi'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi dam pa mthong ba yi/ /gang zag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de bzhin no/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs | | bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /shes rab zab mos shin tu bstan pa yi/ /'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam bsgom zhing*/ /lus kyang sbyin par yid la byas pa ni/ /de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang 'phrad mi 'gyur | | des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba/ /lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa nyid/ /de ltar kun tu sbyor ba rab btang ba/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/

/de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder gyur cig /ston mchog lha dang mis ni mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog / 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur cig /'di ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /shin tu bden pa gsung zhing brdzun med pa/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig swā hā// //shis pa brjod pa ste bco lnga pa'o// //༄༅/ /rgyud ∶sde'i (《 zha 》 'bum gyi )dkar chag bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti singnghaṃ/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥn ma bhaṭṭā rā ka badzra nghā rā ya | rdo rje 'chang chen nyid kyi thugs rje yis/ /gzhan gyi don du skye bo'i skur bstan nas/ /skal ba ji bzhin gdul bya'i don mdzad pa/ /sa skya'i bla chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rje btsun rin po che rgyal mtshan gyi mthas rnam par brgyan pa'i zhal snga nas/ bod du 'gyur ba'i yang dag pa'i rgyud sde rin po che bzhi po phal mo che'i mtshan phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa las gnyis su med pa'i rgyud thog mar smos shing*/ bla ma chos kyi rjes bsgyur ba'i rgyud rnams bsnan te bṛ bar bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud la kye'i rdo rje rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ thun mong gi bshad pa'i rgyud dpal saṃ pu ṭa thig le'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/

brtag pa gnyis pa'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi mar grags pa phyag rgya chen po'i thig le/ ye shes thig le/ de kho na'i sgron ma/ gsang ba'i sgron ma/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ste thig le'i rgyud lnga/ ye shes snying po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ rnyog pa med pa'i ā ralli/ rdo rje ā ra lli/ ṛ gi ā ralli/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ dam pa dang po'i rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud bsdus pa/ dbang gi don ston pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu/ mgon po mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho mchog tu gsang ba las thod pa brtag pa'i rgyud gsum | mi g.yo ba'i rgyud gsang ba chen po rnams(《 zha 》+ so/ ) / shes rab kyi rgyud la 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud mkha' 'gro ma kun spyod | a bhi ngha na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ he ru ka mngon 'byung*/ phag mo mngon 'byung*/ sdom pa 'byung ba/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi pa kha sbyor gyi rgyud/ 'bum pa gsum pa las ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i nang nas byung ba'i le'u gcigasangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ zla gsang thig le | rdo rje gdan bzhi/ dbang gi don ston/ rgyud kyi dum bu/ mant+ra aṃ sa/ bshad rgyud chen mo/ ma hā mā yā/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi rnams so// thabs kyi rgyud la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma/ rdo rje phreng ba/ dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag gzhon nu gdong drug rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rnam par snang mdzad/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnams so/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa/ rdo rje rtse mo/ dpal mchog dang po/ khams gsum rnam rgyal | mgon po kun snang*/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud | rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud/

thams cad gsang ba rnams so/ /bla ma chos kyi rje'i zhal snga nas bsgyur ba ni/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/∶'du ba rab gsal | (《 zha 》 'di rnal 'byor bla med kyi nang nas thabs kyi rgyud du 'du bar gsal la/ ) sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba nor bu thig le rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du 'du bar gsal la/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud bya ba'i rgyud kyi khongs su 'du mod kyi/ 'gyur mdzad pa po gcig pa'i phyir/ phyogs gcig tu bris pa'o/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud | 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud/ gshin rje gshed khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud | pra khog bslang rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa chen po(《 zha 》+ rnams so/ ) / bya ba'i rgyud la rigs gsum so so'i rgyud/ rig pa'i lha mo'i rgyud/ thun mong gi rgyud gsum las/ rigs gsum so so'i 'jam dpal gyi rgyud la dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa/ dum bu'i rgyud la 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa/ 'jam dpal gyi dmod btsugs pa/ shes rab blo 'phel | shes rab bskyed pa/ 'jam dpal gho ṣa ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal la lha mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/ 'jam dpal yig 'bru gcig pa rnams so | | spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud la/ don yod zhags pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa chen po/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong gi rtog pa rgyas pa/ thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs/ za ma tog bkod pa'i rtog pa rgyas pa/ spyan ras gzigs ha la ha la'i rtog pa rgyas pa/ 'phags pa mi kha la/ snying rje mi bshol ba'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi yum/ spyan ras gzigs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'khor los sgyur ba'i rtog pa chen po/ ha ya gṛ wa'i gzungs kyi dum bu/ seng ge sgra'i dam bcas pa'i gzungs kyi dum bu rnams so/

/phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud la/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ kṛ ya rig pa mchog gi rgyud/ dpung pa bzang po/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud snga 'dres gcig rdo rje rnam 'joms/ de'i bshad rgyud/ ri rab khang bu brtsegs pa/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar ∶'bar ba (《 zha 》 rab tu ) rmongs byed/ rdo rje snying po'i gzungs/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs | 'phags pa stobs po che'i gzungs/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i gzungs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dum bu/ 'phags pa rdo rje mchu/ gnam lcags mchu/ lcags kyi mchu/ lcags kyi mchu nag po/ drang srong gis klu la dmod bor ba'i gzungs | klu'i rgyal po sogs med pa'i rtog pa rgyas pa rnams so/ /rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyi gzungs la/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar rgyas 'bring gsum/ sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud/ ku ru kulle'i rtog pa/ 'od zer can gyi rtsa ba'i sngags/ de'i rtog pa chen po/ 'phags pa rdo rje lcags sgrog skul byed ma'i gzungs/ gza' rnams kyi yum/ gzungs grwa lnga/ 'phags pa be con nag (《 zha 》 chen ) po/ 'phags pa yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du 'jug pa/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ 'phags pa rnam par rgyal ba/ 'phags pa phyir bzlog pa rnam par rgyal ba can ma/ thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin ma/ phyir bzlog pa stobs can ma/ bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ma/ 'phags pa dug sel ma/ mdangs phyir 'phrog pa'i gzungs/ rin chen phreng ba'i dum bu/ 'phags pa rgyal ba can/ parṇa sha ba ri'i gzungs/ me ltar 'bar ba'i gzungs/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo sgron ma mchog dbyig ldan ma'i gzungs/ yi ge drug pa'i gzungs/ 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo/ dpal chen mo'i gzungs/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/

rims nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ mig nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ mig nad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs/ gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo/ mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum/ gtsug gi nor bu'i gzungs/ tsandan gyi yan lag dri ma med pa/ stong 'khyil ba/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum gyi gzungs/ byang chub snying po rgyan gyi gzungs rnams so// //thun mong gi rgyud la/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po/ gsang ba spyi rgyud | legs par grub pa/ bsam gtan phyi ma/ gser 'od dam pa/ 'og min gyi tshe dpag med/ bde ba can gyi tshe dpag med/ chos kyi rgya mtsho/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang*/ 'jigs pa brgyad las sgrol ba/ gzungs chen po gsang ba'i ring bsrel gyi za ma tog sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs/ mtshan mo bzang po/ 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la/ ye shes ta la la/ ye shes skar mda'/ me tog brtsegs pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo kun nas 'od/ kun tu bzang po'i gzungs/ gser can gyi gzungs/ 'dus pa chen po'i gzungs/ kun tu rgyu ba dang mthun pa dang mi mthun pa/ sangs rgyas bdun pa/ bu mang po rton pa/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi yan lag dang ldan pa/ sor mo can/ lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa/ bde ba bsgrags pa/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs

| stong 'gyur/ kaṃ ka ni'i gzungs/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i gzungs/ bdud rtsi sman gyi gzungs/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa'i gzungs/ sprin chen po las char dbab pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i ∶le'u(《 zha 》 gzungs/ ) / klu thams cad kyi snying po/ 'dus pa chen po rin chen tog 'dus pa chen po nyi ma'i snying po/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rnams so// //snga 'gyur gyi rgyud la/ rdo rje phur pa'i rtsa ba'i dum bu/ gsang ba snying po/ sgyu 'phrul bla ma/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul/ thabs kyi zhags pa/ sgyu 'phrul brgyad cu pa rnams so// //'jig rten pa'i rgyud la/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i gzungs/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs/ gar mkhan mchog gi rtog pa chen po rnams so// //de ltar shin tu zab pa'i don ston pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde dam pa rnams | | dri med rin chen gser gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /bri bar 'dod pa'i lhag bsam dang ldan pa/ /'bri klung dam pa chos phyug ldan stod du/ /smon lam dag pas nye bar skyes gyur pa/ /ston seng zhes byas rje btsun rin chen la/ /dri med rgyud kyi mtshan phreng zhus mod kyang*/ /sbyor ba rtsom bzhin rkyen gyis ma grub pa/ / de yi dbon po blo gros dang ldan pa/ /dbang phyug rgyal po zhes byas rab 'bad nas | | dpal ldan chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta'i/ /zhabs pad dri med yun ring brten byas nas/ /gsung rab bdud rtsis blo gros tshims par byas/ /de yi tsha bo bkra shis tshul khrims dpal/ /bzang po zhes bya ming gzhan dbon nag tu/ /grags pa des kyang dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /'phags pa zhes byar yongs su grags gyur pa'i | |

zhabs pad btud nas chos kyi bdud rtsi nos/ /de yi bla ma'i bka' drin dran phyir dang*/ /rgyal po yab sras sku tshe ring phyir dang*/ khu mes dag gi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /rgyal khams chos bzhin bde legs bya phyir dang | | rang gi bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /hor gyi rgyal rabs lnga pa'i rgyal po mchog /ga gan rgyal po zhes bya'i sku ring la/ /chu mo bya lo dbyar zla dus kyi tshe/ /bai ḍūrya yi zhing khams dag pa la/ /gser bzang 'bar bas tshul bzhin bzhengs pa dang*/ /bklags dang mchod la sogs pa'i dge ba yis/ / bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang thob par shog /tshe rabs kun tu gsung rab 'di dag dang*/ /gzhan yang chos tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la/ /nye bar zhugs shing rtogs pa mchog gyur te/ / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher ston par shog /gnas skabs chos kyi rgyal po yon mchod dang*/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /tshe ring nad med phun gsum tshogs pa dang*/ /blo kun chos dang mthun zhing bde legs shog | ∶'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ //(《 zha 》 zab don ston pa rdo rje theg mchog gi /mtshan rnams phyogs gcig tu ni gsal sdebs pa'i/ /dge ba dri med kun da'i 'od mtshungs des/ /bdag gzhan rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig |rgyud sde bzhi bod du 'gyur ba'i yang dag pa rnams nang tshegs kyi dbye bas gsal bar mtshan rnams phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa 'di ni chu mo bya'i dbyar gyi dus su rgya nag po'i yul du 'phags pas sbyar ba'o| | ) ༄༅/ /∶mgon po'i sgrub yig (《 zha 》 dpal rdo rje nag po lcam dral gyi sgrub pa'i thabs ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid bla ma dam pa dang*/ /kye yi rdo rje dpal mgon phyag 'tshal nas | | dri med bstan pa rab tu bsrung ba'i phyir/

/nag po chen po sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad/ /de la 'dir 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur le'u bco lnga pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud bsdus pa las 'byung ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi man ngag gis yang dag par brgyan pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sgrub pa'i thabs yan lag dang bcas pa 'di ni/ dad pa dang gzhan la brtse bas kun nas bslangs nas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang bcas pa la gsol ba btab ste bṛ bar bya'o/ /de'ang dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i bla mas rjes su gnang ba nos pa'i gang zag gis/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po bsgrub par 'dod pas don gsum gyis rtogs par bya ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o/ /de dag kyang rkyang du sgrub pa dang | sbags te sgrub pa gnyis las/ 'dir sbags te sgrub pa bshad par bya'o// de la thog mar bsnyen pa ni rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i bsnyen pa sngon du song nas mchod gtor la brten te bsnyen pa bya'o/ /de la gnyis/ mchod gtor gyis mnyes par bya ba dang*/ sngags kyi bzlas pa nyid ji ltar bya ba'o/ /dang po la'ang yo byad bshams pa dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis so/ /dang po ni gnas khang dben par dmigs pa'i rten bris sku la sogs pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang*/ dug dang nyungs dkar dang*/ tshil chen bsres pa yi dwags kyi mes bsregs pa'i bdug pa rgyun mi 'chad ∶pa (《 zha 》 par bya ba ) ni khyad par ro/ /gtor ma ni 'bras chan la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dang*/ mon sran gre'u dang*/ sgog skya dang*/ sha sna tshogs pa bsres te bsngos ( brngos ) pa ni 'dzam bu ti ba yin la/ gzhan yang sha sna tshogs pa don snying lngas brgyan pa dang*/ khrag sna tshogs pa zhun chen pos brgyan pa la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa bshams te/ dar nag gi 'phan dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang lda ldis mdzes par byas nas/

bdud rtsi ril bus sbags la chang dang chus sbyangs pa ni gtor ma'o/ /de ltar yo byad phun sum tshogs par byas nas/ mchod gtor dngos la bzhi/ rdzas kyi ting nge 'dzin | mgron gyi ting nge 'dzin/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul ba/ bstod cing phrin las gzhol ba'o/ /dang po ni rang nyid yi dam lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas thog mar mchod pa byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas ma dag pa bsang*/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod pa'i khyad par phun sum tshogs par bskyed la/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtor ma la lag pa g.yon pa bstan nas oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan nas āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che bar bsam/ gnyis ka bstan nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang bar bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang*/ hoḥzhes brjod pas kha dog dang*/ dri dang nus pa phun gsum tshogs par bsam ∶pa ni rdzas kyi'o(《 zha 》 de rdzas kyi ting nge 'dzin no ) / /gnyis pa mgron gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dbus su dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus te de nyid la thim pas rkyen byas nas/ rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa | sku thung zhing sbom la brjid pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa dgra bgegs kyi khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ phyag ∶gi (《 zha 》 gnyis ka'i ) dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇḍī bsnams pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa me mdag gi phung po ltar dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/

zhal mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing | smin ma'i dbus na khro gnyer bsdus pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang | rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan zhing*/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sprul pa'i pho nya du ma spro ba dang bsdu ba'i bdag nyid du bsam mo/ /de'i g.yon du padma dang nyi ma'i steng du trag las/ e ka dzā ṭī sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can | phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing*/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bskyed la/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du/ bhyo las 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/(《 zha 》+ sku mdog sngon nag ) zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung*/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas zhal mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang pos ska rags byas shing zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis mdzes par byas pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang*/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ sku la khrag dang zhag gi thig le dang zo ris su bris pa/ lte ba'i thad nas nyi zla 'char ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i don shal can/ lcam dral gnyis ka ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o | | de nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa dang*/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo spyan drangs pa la mgo thod la sogs pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas/ mdzub mo g.yab cing ngag tu/ mgon po 'dir gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bdag can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pa dang | oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya e hye hi/ zhes bya bas mgon po spyan drangs/ de bzhin du/ lha mo 'dir gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang | ma hā kā lī de wī e hye hi/ zhes bya bas lha mo spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ de nas padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas so so'i padma'i gdan dbul lo/ /gsum pa mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dbul ba ni/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ shrī ma hā kā lā ya gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul lo/ /arghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā dyaṃ gis zhabs bsil dbul | puṣpaṃ gyis me tog dhū paṃ gyis bdug spos/ dī paṃ gyis mar me/ gandhaṃ gyis dri chab/ nai wi dye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis zhal zas dbul lo/ /de bzhin du ma hā kā lī de wī gṛhṇe daṃ zhes pa la sogs pas lha mo yang mchod par bya'o | | de nas skabs 'dir dam la bzhag par bya ste/ thal mo snying gar sbyar ba mgon po'i phyag rgya de nyid las/ sor mo rnams bsnol ba lha mo'i phyag rgya ste/ de ltar dam tshig phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ sa ma ya smā ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma sa ma ya rakṣantu/ zhes brjod nas rdo rje spyi bor bzhag par bsams la | rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dpal rdo rje nag po chen pos dam tshig srungs shig sgrub pa po bdag cag gi 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/
