bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sgrub pa po bdag cag la gnod cing 'gal bar byed pa'i gdon dang*/ log 'dren thams cad thal ba rdul du brlag par mdzod cig ces dam la bzhag go /de nas gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ∶ba'i (《 zha 》 ba bstan pa'i ) phyag rgya bcas la/ yid kyis nag po chen po dang lha mo'i zhal nas 'od zer gyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing ngag tu/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥ bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul bas mnyes par byas shing tshim par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du shrī ma hā kā lā ya'i gnas su/ ma hā kā lī de wī zhes pa dang | de nyid bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i gnas su dpal lha mo nag mo zhes sbyar nas lha mo dam la bzhag pa dang*/ gtor ma phul bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa bstod cing phrin las gzhol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ rnga brdung zhing*/ cung zad khro tshul dang bcas pas bstod par bya ste/ hūm̐ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa/ /nag po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod phreng can la bdag bstod do/ khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /zhes pa la sogs pas nag po chen po bstod nas/ lha mo la bstod pa ni/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod kyi sku/

/dbang po sngon po lta bur 'bar | | ri rab lhun po ltar bur brjid/ /nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa 'gyed/ / dbu skra ser po gyen du 'khyil/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug /mi ro khar bcug mche ba gtsigs/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon chas phyag rnams brel/ /mi mgo rin chen rus pas brgyan/ /klu dbang seng ge lcags sgrog dang*/ khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan/ /ko rlon re lde gos su gyon/ /bong bu gwar zhon mtshan mor rgyu/ /shin tu rid cing mi sdug ma/ / 'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs/ / 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra sgrogs pas/ khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas// sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zhi la rab gzhol yang*/ /snying rje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs/ khro dang 'khrugs dang rngam pa yis/ /bdud dpung nges par 'joms la 'dud/ khyod kyis phrin las mi bzad pa/ /rnam 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pa'i tshe/ /lha dang lha min klu dbang dang*/ /gshin rje'i tshogs kyis phyag byas ma/ khyod kyis 'jig rten khams kun gyi/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug bsdus nas/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i dug slong mdzad/ /'jig rten khams kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i sman bsdus nas/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi nad sel zhing*/ /re 'dod yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ /de ltar tshar bcad rjes bzung bas/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad ma/ khyed la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi 'dod pa'i don kun sgrubs/ khyod kyi dang po thub pa dang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyan snga ru/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig can gyi tshogs

| | thams cad bu bzhin bskyang ngo zhes/ /dam bcas bzhin du rjes dgongs la/ /dam tshig de las ma 'da' bar/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyis | | bde gshegs bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ /bdag gi 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /yid bzhin du ni 'grub par mdzod/ /sems can la 'tshe thub pa yi | | bstan la gnod par byed pa dang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag cag la/ / gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa/ /mi dang mi min gang ci'ang rung*/ /dpung dang bcas pa'i phyogs kun la/ khyaud kyis dug gi rlangs phyung nas/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams kyis/ /kun tu gzir nas gsad par gyis/ /gang yang bdag sogs rnal 'byor pa/ /dam tshig la gnas thams cad la/ khyod kyi zhal nas bdud rtsi'i char/ /phab nas sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang*/ /longs spyod dbang thang 'phel ba dang*/ /'gro kun dbang du 'du bar gyis/ /zhes bya bas lha mo la bstod par bya'o/ /bskul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyo/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā lā ya/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /ma hā de wa'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po ma hā kā la dang*/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/ sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /'dzam bu ti ba'i zhas zas 'di bzhes shig /dza gad dpa' bo sman phud 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtong rag gnyen por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsal 'debs gnyen por bzhes | | 'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams zlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po// thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/

/srid zhi'i dpal 'byor thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /tshe ring nad med ∶longs spyod (《 zha 》 bde skyid ) phun sum tshogs/ /don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ / ces bya bas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par bya ba bstan zin to// //gnyis pa bzlas pa nyid ji ltar bya ba ni/ rang yi dam gyi lhar bsam pa'i thugs kar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas | nag po chen po dang lha mo'i thugs kar phog ste/ de dag gi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bskul ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya ste/ de'ang bsnyen pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs n-i 'bum phrag bcu gnyis so/ /de ltar bsnyen pa song nas rtsa ba'i sngags la bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa a paṣtsī ma kā lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya de pra ti dzña sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣtāṃ/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐ zhes bya ba'o// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum phrag bzhi'o/ /de nas lha mo'i bzlas pa la'ang de nyid kyi thun gyi rjes la bya ste/ dmigs pa ni sngar dang 'dra ba la sngags ni/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣṭha/ ba dhwat+si ka la ma rākṣa sī hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ zhes bya ba ste/ grangs ni 'bum phrag bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs kyang brgyad du byas na 'thad ces gsung ngo*// de ltar grangs kyi bsnyen pa them pa dang*/ mtshan ma 'byung ba ni/

nag po chen po dang lha mo dngos sam/ rmi lam du mthong ba'am/ bya nag dang*/ khyi nag dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ bud med nag mo'i tshogs 'du zhing bdag la dga' ba'i tshul byed pa dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa la sogs pa ni mtshan ma'o/ / de dag gis ni bsnyen pa bstan zin to// //gnyis pa sgrub pa la gnyis las/ rten bca' ba ni/ rab tu dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i khang pa'am dur khrod la sogs par sa stegs mda' gang ba'i tshad dang ldan pa'i maṇḍal gru bzhi byas la/ ba byung lnga dang*/ dri lnga bdud rtsi'i ril bu dang bcas pa dang*/ mar chen po dang khrag chen pos byugs nas/ de'i dbus su dur khrod kyi sol bas khru gang pa'i tshad kyi gru gsum du byugs pa'i dkyil du rang byung gi me tog gis thig le byas la/ me tog tshom bu gnyis dgod | gru gsum gyi rtse mo phar bstan pa'i rtser bshos bu gru gsum pa khru gang pa dang*/ g.yas zur du dar nag gi 'phan dang*/ mgon po'i bris sku gzugs/ g.yon zur du byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nag po khru gang ba rab gnas byas pa cig bzhag gzhan yang mchod pa dang gtor ma'i yo byad sngar bstan pa ltar rgya chen po bsham mo/ /gnyis pa ji ltar bsgrub pa ni/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i tshe/ sgrub pa'i grogs 'ga' zhig gis yi dam gyi lha'i sngags dang*/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ rim gro rgya chen po byed du gzhug bdag nyid ky-is nyi shu dgu'i mtshan mo tshaugs kyi 'khor lo phun sum tshogs pa byas la/ byang chub kyi sems sngon du song ba'i drag shul gyi bsam pas kun nas bslangs nas/ srod la srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas yi dam gyi lha'i bzlas bsgom rdzogs pa dang*/ mdun du bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal gyi rten bskyed par bya ste/ chang la bdud rtsis sbyar ba gtor zhing*/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ sā bhā was sbyang | stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las nag po chen po snga ma ltar bskyed/
